Class SocketNetworkManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.NetworkManager
it.polimi.ingsw.network.SocketNetworkManager
public class SocketNetworkManager extends NetworkManager
Handles client-side network operations using TCP Sockets. It extends NetworkManager to translate high-level user interface actions into formatted text commands sent over the socket connection to the server.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public void connect(String ip, int port) throws Exception
      Establishes a TCP connection to the server using the provided IP address and port. It initializes the output stream and spawns a dedicated background thread running a SocketServerListener to asynchronously process incoming server messages.
      Specified by:
      connect in class NetworkManager
      Parameters:
      ip - the server IP address to connect to
      port - the server port number to connect to
      Throws:
      Exception - if an I/O error occurs when creating the socket or the streams

    • login

      public void login(Color color, String name)
      Sends a login request command to the server with the player's chosen nickname and color. Spaces inside the nickname are automatically replaced with underscores to maintain command protocol formatting compliance.
      Specified by:
      login in class NetworkManager
      Parameters:
      color - the chosen player color
      name - the requested player nickname
